title: Error after low-degree truncation
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$. The square of the uniform $2$-norm of the difference between $f$ and its degree-at-most-$k$ Fourier part equals the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of $f$ over all subsets of coordinates whose sizes exceed $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean cube $\{-1,1\}^n$
